def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    zc=None
    for c in range(w):
        s={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(s)==1 and cnt[next(iter(s))]==h: zc=c; break
    lbg=Counter(g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(zc)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rbg=Counter(g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(zc+1,w)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    inv=(lbg==rbg)
    v=lbg  # shared/agreement value
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        left=g[r][:zc]; right=g[r][zc+1:]
        eq=[left[c]==right[c] for c in range(zc)]
        if inv:  # bgs equal -> mark differences with color v, bg 3
            out.append([v if not e else 3 for e in eq])
        else:    # bgs differ -> mark agreements with 3, bg v
            out.append([3 if e else v for e in eq])
    return out
